fuente.titulo: Pope in Buenos Aires: Religions must build bridges, not division

titular: Pope Leo calls for interfaith unity in Buenos Aires
bajada: He urged religious leaders to build bridges, not division, during Argentina visit
caption: Meeting with leaders of Christian communities and other religious traditions in Buenos Aires, Pope Leo XIV called for dialogue, fraternity, and a shared commitment to human dignity and hope. Source: Vatican News, Nov 9, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Grand cathedral interior in Buenos Aires at dusk, with a pope-like figure in white vestments seen from behind greeting a diverse group of religious leaders, positioned in upper right, left and center space open
